about: Hand labels for the matching eval, drafted by Claude from the ground-truth descriptions and fields, to be reviewed by a human. Grades: 3 = a player would very likely enjoy it next, 2 = clearly related, 1 = loosely related. mustNot = should never appear for this seed. Labels are brand-agnostic: the scorer only counts games that are live on the requesting brand.
